messages:
alyssa: Heads up — I noticed a user with View-only role got Editor buttons in console for a specific project. Possible role aggregation bug after last matrix change. Anyone seen this? :thinking:

jia: hmm, can you DM the user id? or share a repro steps here

alyssa: user: U112233, repro: go to Projects → select 'Beta-Edge' → top-right 'Edit project' is clickable. Happens on staging and prod for org 501.

marco: could be the new 'team_admin' composite we added. If team_admin aggregates editor perms for project owners it might leak. I'll check the migration script.

sec-bot: audit-entry found: {
  "ts": "2026-03-19T21:12:03Z",
  "actor": "U112233",
  "action": "ui.click.edit_project",
  "result": "allowed",
  "effective_roles": ["viewer","team_admin"]
}

alyssa: that's the one. Why is team_admin showing up in effective_roles? They only had viewer in the role matrix UI.

marco: hypothesis: role matrix change added implicit binding for team_admin if user is listed as project owner in postgres. migration might have flagged owners -> team_admin. I'll run a query: SELECT roles FROM project_members WHERE user_id='U112233';

jia: also check KMS-encrypted attrs — we store role_bindings in KMS-wrapped blob for private deployments; if decryption failed fallback might map to default 'team_admin' — weird but possible.

marco: running quick check now, will paste results.

marco: query result snippet:
```
user_id | roles
U112233 | {"viewer"}
owner   | true
```

marco: interesting — db says viewer + owner flag true. owner flag was previously a soft attribute; the new role mapper treats owner=true as team_admin.

alyssa: that's the change. We probably didn't update the UI gating check to treat owner differently. Need a hotfix: either change mapper to not map owner->team_admin or change UI gating to consult owner flag separately.

jia: agree. Priorities: 1) patch role-mapper 2) add audit alert for unexpected effective_roles combos 3) run backfill to identify impacted users 4) KMS edge-case check.

marco: I'll open a PR with mapper patch and a migration to clear owner->team_admin mapping on staging. tagging @ops-runbook for deploy guidance.

ops-runbook: for emergency hotfix deploy to staging then prod: use canary in eu-west then global. Keep retention of audit logs at 90d for this incident.

alyssa: also add a regression test that UI permission gating uses both role list and owner flag (explicit precedence).

marco: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3345 — includes unit tests and a small telemetry spike to flag when effective_roles includes team_admin and viewer together.

jia: nice. Also check KMS decryption path: if decryption fails we currently fallback silently to 'admin' set — we should fail closed. I'll open a follow-up.

alyssa: thanks everyone. let's sync tomorrow after a limited prod rollout. :thumbsup:
